block.comment: Titan Range Premium: fixed stake; streak entry requires 40/120-tick frequency agreement. Margins are percentage points above uniform-digit frequency, not win probabilities. Pauses: 10 seconds after wins, 30 after losses. Trailing drawdown activates at 1 profit. The next stake must fit both loss budgets. Historical digit patterns do not guarantee the next digit. Limits reset on manual restart. Demo-test before live use.

block.field: Titan Range Premium: session stopped. Check profit target, remaining loss/trailing budget, trade count, loss streak and stake cap.
